baseUrl.description: The start page: a full URL, or a path like "/admin" on the site of the environment.

environment.description: The environment to run in, like staging, when the tool call and the session do not choose one.

environments.description: The only environments this plan may run in, like [development, staging].

vars.description: Values for {{var:NAME}} in this plan. An environment in config.yaml can change them.

mode.description: interactive: confirm every step. checkpoints: confirm marked steps. autonomous: the agent checks each step.

device.description: Screen preset: desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile, or a Puppeteer device name.

emulate.description: More settings for every tab, like { timezone: Europe/Berlin, cpu: 4 }. device, colorScheme, and network above win over the same keys here.

device.description: desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile, default, or a Puppeteer device name like "Pixel 5".

orientation.description: Turn the device, like a phone on its side. It works with a device, like mobile.

cpu.description: Make the CPU slower by this factor, like 4. 1 is normal speed.

locale.description: A language and region like "de-DE", or "system". It changes date and number formats and the Accept-Language header.

geolocation.description: A place like { latitude: 52.52, longitude: 13.4 }. It also allows location for the login. "off" blocks location for the login.

media.description: Show the page as on screen or as printed.

permissions.description: Browser permissions. They apply to every tab of the same login.

session.description: A saved login to use. Save one with the session tool.

screenshotDir.description: The folder for step screenshot paths, from the project folder, like "docs/images/help".

accessibility.description: Settings for accessibility checks in this plan.

report.description: Write an accessibility report when the run ends.

checks.description: Turn extra checks on or off: keyboard, darkMode, reflow, frames, screenshots.

lighthouse.description: Settings for the Lighthouse steps in this plan.

device.description: desktop or mobile scores. The default comes from config.yaml.

categories.description: The categories to check. The default comes from config.yaml.

report.description: Write a Lighthouse report when the run ends.

video.description: Record the whole run as a video. The report shows it.

path.description: Also save the video to this file, from the project folder.

showPanel.description: Show the Walkthrough panel in the video.

mask.description: CSS selectors of things to blur in videos of this run, like customer names. Secrets are always blurred.

captions.description: Show step captions at the bottom.

presentation.description: Settings to play this plan as a live presentation. See docs/presentations.md.

title.description: A slide before the presentation starts. It shows until the presenter clicks Start.

image.description: An image file from the project folder, like ".walkthrough/slides/title.png".

fit.description: contain shows all of the image (default). cover fills the window and can cut the edges.

background.description: The color around the image. The default is black.

title.description: Big text in the middle of the screen.

background.description: The color of the slide. The default is dark gray.

color.description: The color of the text. The default is white.

end.description: The last screen. Without it, the end screen shows the plan name and "Questions?".

image.description: An image file from the project folder, like ".walkthrough/slides/title.png".

fit.description: contain shows all of the image (default). cover fills the window and can cut the edges.

background.description: The color around the image. The default is black.

title.description: Big text in the middle of the screen.

background.description: The color of the slide. The default is dark gray.

color.description: The color of the text. The default is white.

pause.description: before (default): wait for the presenter before each step. none: go on by itself.

pace.description: How fast the pointer moves and the text types. The default is normal.

pointer.description: Show a pointer that moves to each element. Default: true.

spotlight.description: During a pause, dim the page except the element of the next action. Default: true.

captions.description: Show the caption of each step at the bottom of the audience screen. Default: true.

window.description: The size of the audience window, like { width: 1920, height: 1080 }.

pageZoom.description: Make the page bigger, like 1.25, so people at the back of the room can read it.

fullscreen.description: Start the audience window in fullscreen.

device.description: Use the device of the plan, like mobile, on the audience screen. Default: the page fills the window.

mirror.description: Show a small live picture of the audience screen in the presenter window. Default: true.

timeBudget.description: The time for the whole presentation, like "10m". The presenter window warns when it is over.

mask.description: CSS selectors of things to blur on the audience screen, like customer names. Secret fields are always blurred.

record.description: Record the audience screen as a video.

path.description: Also save the video to this file, from the project folder.

kiosk.description: Run without a presenter, such as on a screen at a booth.

holdSeconds.description: How long each step and slide shows. The default is 6.

loop.description: Start again at the title after the end screen.

loops.description: Stop after this many loops. The default is 100.

anyOf.description: The text to copy, like a terminal command.

code.description: The text to copy, like a terminal command.

help.description: More about the snippet. A "?" next to the copy button shows it.

snippets.description: Snippets for {{copy:name}} in panel text, like { seed: "npm run db:seed" }.

browser.description: Browser settings for this plan, like { window: { width: 1440, height: 900 } }.

window.description: The size of the page area, like { width: 1280, height: 800 }. The window fits it.

autofill.description: Chrome offers to save and fill addresses and cards. Default: false.

passwords.description: Chrome offers to save passwords and checks them for leaks. Default: false.

permissionPrompts.description: deny (default): Chrome says no to camera, location, and notification questions. emulate permissions still grant them. ask: Chrome asks.

spellcheck.description: Red lines under words that Chrome thinks are wrong. Default: false.

keepFocus.description: The page acts as if it has focus when you click in another window, so menus stay open. Default: true.

language.description: The language of Chrome and of the Accept-Language header, like "de-DE".

downloads.description: Save downloads in the run folder with no Save dialog, and list them in the report. Default: false.

fakeMedia.description: A fake camera and microphone, with no question. Default: false.

autoplay.description: Video and sound can play without a click. Default: false.

thirdPartyCookies.description: Cookies of other sites in frames. Default: allow.

fontSize.description: Chrome font sizes, to test larger text.

zoom.description: Page zoom for the sites of the app, like 1.25.

devtools.description: Open DevTools in each tab. A visible browser only.

dock.description: Where DevTools shows. window: in a window of its own. Default: right.

deviceToolbar.description: Show DevTools' device toolbar. Then DevTools controls the page size, and emulate cannot set a device.

extensions.description: Folders of unpacked extensions, like React DevTools. From the project folder.

hosts.description: Send a host name to another address, like { "api.example.com": "127.0.0.1" }.

secureOrigins.description: http sites that Chrome treats as secure, like "http://dev.test:8080", so the clipboard and service workers work there.

automationBar.description: The "controlled by automated test software" bar. Default: true.

panel.description: Panel labels, buttons, and the "What's next" part for every step. A step "panel" replaces the same settings for that step.

labels.description: Labels of the parts of the panel.

did.description: The label above what the agent did. The default is "What I did". "" shows no label.

expect.description: The label above what the developer should see. The default is "What you should see". "" shows no label.

next.description: The label above what comes next. The default is "What's next". "" shows no label.

command.description: The label above the terminal command of the step. The default is "Run this command". "" shows no label.

buttons.description: Text and colors of the answer buttons, like { pass: { label: Done } }.

color.description: The button color. Walkthrough picks a text color that is easy to read on it.

collapsed.description: Start with "What's next" closed. Default: true.

auto.description: A step without "next" shows the "do" of the next step.

corner.description: Where the panel starts. Default: bottom-right.

progress.description: A list of all steps and their results. A button in the panel header shows it. Default: true.

shortcuts.description: Answer with Alt+Shift+P, B, S, R, and X (Option+Shift on a Mac). Default: true.

id.description: A short id for the step. Reports and scripts use it.

do.description: What to do, in plain words. A card step does not need it.

card.description: Show a card, like a start or end message, and wait for the developer.

heading.description: Big text at the top of the card.

content.description: The text of the card. It can have lists, check lists, and code.

size.description: panel (default): in the Walkthrough panel. modal: big, in the middle of the page.

when.description: always (default). passed: only when no step so far has a bug or failed. problems: only when one has.

expect.description: What the developer should see after the step. Make it specific.

checkpoint.description: In checkpoints mode, ask the developer to confirm this step.

navigate.description: A URL or a path like "/cart".

name.description: The name the user sees, like "Checkout".

value.description: Text to type, option to choose, or key to press.

files.description: Files to upload, from the project folder.

wait.description: Text to wait for on the page.

url.description: The page to open. A full URL, or a path like "/login".

name.description: A name for the tab. Later steps switch to it by name.

isolated.description: true for a new login of its own. A name for a login that tabs share.

session.description: A saved login to load into the tab.

switchTab.description: The tab to use now: a name, or "newest" for the tab that opened last. { tab: newest, name: help } also names it.

tab.description: A tab name, an id, or "newest".

name.description: A name to give the tab.

closeTab.description: The name or id of the tab to close.

action.description: An exact action for this step. The agent uses it instead of guessing.

anyOf.description: Where to save the file, from the project folder or from screenshotDir.

path.description: Where to save the file, from the project folder or from screenshotDir.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole page, not only the visible part.

screenshot.description: Save a screenshot after this step. true saves it with the run. A path saves it to that exact file, and replaces the file if it exists.

visual.description: Compare a screenshot with the saved baseline after this step.

emulate.description: Settings for the tab of this step, like { device: mobile }. They apply before the step.

device.description: desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile, default, or a Puppeteer device name like "Pixel 5".

orientation.description: Turn the device, like a phone on its side. It works with a device, like mobile.

cpu.description: Make the CPU slower by this factor, like 4. 1 is normal speed.

locale.description: A language and region like "de-DE", or "system". It changes date and number formats and the Accept-Language header.

geolocation.description: A place like { latitude: 52.52, longitude: 13.4 }. It also allows location for the login. "off" blocks location for the login.

media.description: Show the page as on screen or as printed.

permissions.description: Browser permissions. They apply to every tab of the same login.

cookies.description: Cookie checks after this step, like [{ name: session, httpOnly: true }].

exists.description: false checks that the cookie is gone. The default is true.

value.description: The exact value. {{secret:NAME}} and {{unique}} work here.

contains.description: Text that the value has in it.

mock.description: Mock rules to add before this step, like [{ url: /api/stock, status: 500 }]. They stay on for later steps. "off" removes all mocks.

url.description: The address to match. "/api/stock" matches the path on any site. A full URL or a pattern with * matches the whole address.

urlRegex.description: A regular expression for the whole address.

type.description: Only this resource type, like "fetch", "xhr", "document", "image", or "script".

tab.description: Only this tab, by name or id. Default: every tab.

json.description: A JSON body to answer with.

body.description: A text body to answer with.

contentType.description: The content type. Default: from json or text.

block.description: Fail the request, as if the network blocked it.

times.description: Use the rule this many times, then stop.

selector.description: Check only this part of the page.

checks.description: Extra checks for this step, like [keyboard, darkMode].

caption.description: The text viewers see in a video of this step. Without it, videos show "do".

lighthouse.description: Measure this step with Lighthouse. navigation: Lighthouse loads the page of the navigate action. timespan: it measures what the step does. snapshot: it checks the page after the step.

notes.description: Notes for the presenter. Only the presenter window shows them.

pause.description: In a presentation, wait for the presenter before this step. false goes on by itself. The default comes from presentation.pause.

slide.description: A slide before the action of this step, or the whole step when it has no action. Test runs skip a step that is only a slide.

image.description: An image file from the project folder, like ".walkthrough/slides/title.png".

fit.description: contain shows all of the image (default). cover fills the window and can cut the edges.

background.description: The color around the image. The default is black.

title.description: Big text in the middle of the screen.

background.description: The color of the slide. The default is dark gray.

color.description: The color of the text. The default is white.

spotlight.description: In a presentation, dim the page except the element of this step during the pause.

zoom.description: In a presentation, show the area of the next action this many times bigger during the pause.

timeBudget.description: The time for this step in a presentation, like "45s".

next.description: What comes after this step. The panel shows it under "What's next".

command.description: A command for a terminal, like "npm run db:seed". The panel shows it with a Copy button. The agent can run it after the developer says yes.

help.description: What the command does. A "?" button shows it.

anyOf.description: The text to copy, like a terminal command.

code.description: The text to copy, like a terminal command.

help.description: More about the snippet. A "?" next to the copy button shows it.

snippets.description: Snippets for {{copy:name}} in panel text, like { seed: "npm run db:seed" }.

expectImage.description: An image of what the page should look like, from the project folder. The panel shows it under "What you should see".

panel.description: Panel labels and buttons for this step. They replace the same settings in the plan "panel".

labels.description: Labels of the parts of the panel.

did.description: The label above what the agent did. The default is "What I did". "" shows no label.

next.description: The label above what comes next. The default is "What's next". "" shows no label.
